reason: The commit centralizes existing millisecond-to-timeval arithmetic in the internal helper ares_timeval_add and replaces equivalent calculations in existing timeout paths. It introduces no new externally supplied input, protocol, configuration, state transition, or attack surface requiring H0 to model. Although H0 does not directly invoke these timeout functions, that is not a commit-induced material harness gap because the affected entry points and timeout semantics already existed in S0.
evidence: server_increment_failures and ares_send_query replace calls to the removed static timeadd with ares_timeval_add using the same existing channel->server_retry_delay and timeplus values.
ares_queue_wait_empty remains the same public function with the same channel and timeout_ms parameters; only its timeval addition is delegated to ares_timeval_add.
ares_timeval_add contains the arithmetic formerly implemented by timeadd, including normalization when now->usec >= 1000000.
H0 continues to exercise ares_dns_parse/ares_dns_write and ares_set_servers_csv; the commit does not alter those APIs or their input semantics.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit.
